json_pointer_convention: RFC6901; locator-bearing pointer components use projected role roots. Exact original strings and omitted values remain in private preparation custody.
original_native_record_domain: Unmodified original private native receipt bytes, when the entry states this domain.
v1_input_domain: Exact retained first-publication-candidate metadata bytes; these are not generally original native receipts.
projected_domain: Current public-candidate file bytes after the listed transformations.

role_placeholders.${EXECUTION_ROOT}: Closed joint local execution root; not a portable replay destination.
role_placeholders.${PREPARATION_ROOT}: Pinned joint local source preparation root.
role_placeholders.${REPOSITORY_ROOT}: Repository containing the original bounded execution.
role_placeholders.${LEAN_INSTALLATION_ROOT}: Observed Lean 4.33.0 installation root; source and binary hashes retain their original domains.
role_placeholders.${HISTORICAL_F1F2_PREPARATION_ROOT}: Earlier F1/F2 source closure used for comparison and preservation.
role_placeholders.${HISTORICAL_F4_PREPARATION_ROOT}: Earlier accepted F4 source closure used for comparison and preservation.
role_placeholders.${HISTORICAL_DEPENDENCY_ROOT}: Retained checkout supplying historical dependency inputs.

private_preimage_retention: Original native receipts and complete v1 candidate retained privately without modification; hashes do not themselves supply public retrieval or portable replay.
